question: How do prescribed engineering response timescales and input-sign hypotheses affect a one-state causal receiver of the immutable validated shadow input?

method_preflight.existing_proxy: g1_proxy_passive_electrical.py uses event-boundary increments and virtual G1 voltage semantics; not appropriate for this held-input motor target; no reuse of its biological/parameter mappings
method_preflight.mathematical_basis: Stable scalar linear relaxation is analytically identifiable for prescribed input; its convolution and exact zero-order-hold update follow directly by integrating factor

source_context.resolution: Published half-tanh rate equation contains first-order relaxation; new receiver replaces nonlinear activation with linear engineering input, not a reproduction or biological motor model

source_context.publication: Rotstein and Nadim, J Comput Neurosci 37:9-28 (2014)
source_context.resolution: Primary abstract describes amplitude/phase analysis of linearized neuronal models; context only. Full text blocked via PMC and Europe PMC retrieval failed. No equation or parameter imported from unavailable full text

timescale_basis: Three engineering decades anchored to 1ms source sampling: tau/dt=1,10,100. Largest tau=.1s leaves20 timescales in2s and10 in final1s. Not selected from observed oscillation period, fitted amplitudes or measured target physiology.

timing.input_hold: u[n] on[t[n],t[n+1]); state y[n] before consuming u[n]; y[0]=0; exactly2000 completed intervals
timing.final_boundary: u[2000] recorded but not consumed; no interval beyond2s

metrics.ranges: Full input/output ranges, initial/final state, maximum absolute output and earliest absolute peak time
metrics.peak_time_offset: Time of earliest full-window |output| maximum minus earliest |input| maximum; descriptive/transient-dependent, not a synaptic latency or unique oscillatory phase delay; null for zero input
metrics.temporal_attenuation: Tail centered RMS(output)/centered RMS(input), sampled at matched boundaries; null if input centered RMS==0; not a physiological transfer coefficient
metrics.controls: A=-B, route-off exactly zero, D=A for each timescale; source samples/times identical across all12 runs
metrics.analytical_reference: y(t_n)=exp(-t_n/tau)*y0 + gain*sum_{k<n}u[k]*(exp(-(t_n-t[k+1])/tau)-exp(-(t_n-t[k])/tau)); independently sum all previous held intervals, never call production recurrence
metrics.tolerance_basis: Conservative floating-point summation allowance for2000 terms and states of order100; not biological accuracy
metrics.comparison: Report timescale dependence without arbitrary minimum amplitudes or lag-success criteria

reproducibility: Canonical sorted compact ASCII finite JSON; complete policy, source pins, telemetry and metrics; semantic replay recomputes only isolated receiver and scalar parent transfer; original neural sources never regenerated
chronology: Defined and content-addressed before receiver trajectories; no independently certified prospective timestamp claimed
interpretation: Forced response of an assumed stable linear filter only; no endogenous oscillator, receptor activation, motor recruitment or biological timescale claim
publication: One focused commit and non-force push only after analytic, semantic, isolation, full Python regression, Ruff and frozen-integrity gates pass
